Ya, Seen. These are letters. Only Allah knows what they mean.
Allah swears by the wise Quran.
You are one of the messengers.
You are on a straight path.
This was sent down by the Strong One, the Kind One.
It is to warn a people whose fathers were not warned, so they are not aware.
The word is true against most of them, because they do not believe.
It is as if We put chains around their necks, so they cannot turn toward the truth.
And as if We put a wall in front of them and a wall behind them, and covered them, so they cannot see.
It is the same for them whether you warn them or not. They will not believe.
You can only warn the one who follows the reminder and fears the Most Kind, even when no one sees. Give him the good news of forgiveness and a big reward.
It is We who bring the dead back to life. We write down what they sent ahead and what they left behind. We have counted everything in a clear book.
Tell them the story of the people of the town, when the messengers came to it.
We sent two messengers to them, but they said they were liars. So We helped them with a third. They said: We are messengers to you.
They said: You are only humans like us. The Most Kind did not send down anything. You are only lying.
The messengers said: Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you.
We only have to give the clear message.
They said: We think you bring bad luck. If you do not stop, we will throw stones at you, and you will get a painful punishment from us.
The messengers said: Your bad luck is with you. Is it because you were reminded? You are people who go too far.
Then a man came running from the far end of the city. He said: O my people, follow the messengers!
Follow people who ask you for no pay and who are guided.
Why should I not worship the One who made me, and to whom you will all go back?
Should I take other gods instead of Him? If the Most Kind wants to harm me, they cannot help me at all, and they cannot save me.
Then I would be clearly lost.
I believe in your Lord, so listen to me.
It was said to him: Go into Paradise. He said: I wish my people knew.
How my Lord forgave me and made me one of the honored ones.
After him We did not send any army from the sky to his people, and We never needed to.
It was only one loud cry, and they were silent.
What a pity for the servants! Every messenger who came to them, they laughed at him.
Do they not see how many people before them We destroyed? They will not come back to them.
All of them will be brought together before Us.
There is a sign for them: dead land. We give it life and bring grain out of it, which they eat.
We put gardens of date trees and grapes in it, and made springs flow in it.
So they can eat its fruit, which their hands did not make. Will they not say thank you?
Glory to the One who made everything in pairs, from what the earth grows, from themselves, and from things they do not know.
Another sign for them is the night. We pull the day out of it, and they are in the dark.
And the sun runs to its place. This is the plan of the Strong One, the All-Knowing.
And the moon: We set stages for it, until it looks like an old, dry branch.
The sun cannot catch the moon, and the night cannot pass the day. Each one swims along its own path.
Another sign for them is that We carried their children in a loaded ship.
And We made ships like it for them, which they ride.
If We want, We can drown them. Then no one would hear their cry, and they would not be saved.
Unless We show kindness and let them enjoy for a while.
When it is said to them: Be careful of what is before you and what is behind you, so you may get kindness.
No sign from their Lord ever came to them without them turning away from it.
When it is said to them: Give from what Allah gave you, the people who said no say to the believers: Should we feed someone that Allah could feed if He wanted? You are clearly lost.
They say: When will this promise come, if you are telling the truth?
They are only waiting for one loud blast that will take them while they argue.
They will not be able to say a last wish, and they will not go back to their families.
The horn will be blown, and see, they will hurry out of their graves to their Lord.
They will say: How terrible for us! Who woke us from our sleep? This is what the Most Kind promised, and the messengers told the truth.
It will be only one shout, and see, they will all be brought before Us.
On that Day no person will be treated unfairly at all. You will only get back what you did.
The people of Paradise on that Day will be happy and busy with joy.
They and their wives will rest in shade, on couches.
They will have fruit there, and whatever they ask for.
Peace! This is a word from a Very Kind Lord.
And, O you bad people, step aside today!
Did I not make an agreement with you, children of Adam, that you would not follow Shaytan? He is your clear enemy.
And that you would worship Me? This is a straight path.
He led many of you away. Did you not think?
This is Hell that you were promised.
Burn in it today, because you kept on saying no.
Today We will close their mouths. Their hands will speak to Us and their feet will tell what they did.
If We wanted, We could take away their eyes, so they race to the path. Then how would they see?
And if We wanted, We could freeze them in their place, so they could not go forward or back.
Whoever We give a long life, We make him weak again. Do they not understand?
We did not teach him poetry, and it is not right for him. This is only a reminder and a clear Quran.
So that he can warn whoever is alive, and so the word can be proved against the people who say no.
Do they not see that We made animals for them, from what Our hands made, which they own?
And We made them easy for them. Some they ride and some they eat.
And they have other good things from them, and drinks. Will they not say thank you?
But they took other gods besides Allah, hoping to be helped.
They cannot help them, even if they stand ready like armies for them.
So do not let their words make you sad. We know what they hide and what they show.
Does man not see that We made him from a tiny drop? Yet he becomes a loud fighter against Us.
He makes up a story against Us and forgets how he was made. He says: Who will bring bones back to life when they are rotten?
Say: The One who made them the first time will bring them back. He knows everything about every creation.
He is the One who made fire for you from the green tree, and you light your fires from it.
Is the One who made the sky and the earth not able to make people like them? Yes, He is. He is the Maker and the All-Knowing.
When He wants something, His order is only to say to it: Be! And it is.
So glory to the One in whose hand is the kingdom of everything. And you will all go back to Him.
